data.name: Minhaj
data.gender_notes: Minhaj is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'minhaj', meaning 'a guide', 'a path', or 'a way'. In Islamic context, it refers to following the right path of Allah and seeking guidance from the Quran and the teachings of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him). The name Minhaj carries the meaning “A guide, a path” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Minhaj usually hope their child will grow to embody a guide, a path and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Minhaj total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
